1.text: Ariko noneho Uwiteka wakuremye wowe Yakobo, kandi akakubumba wowe Isirayeli, aravuga ati “Witinya kuko nagucunguye, naguhamagaye mu izina ryawe uri uwanjye.

2.text: Nunyura mu mazi nzaba ndi kumwe nawe, nuca no mu migezi ntizagutembana. Nunyura mu muriro ntuzashya, kandi ibirimi byawo ntibizagufata

3.text: kuko ndi Uwiteka Imana yawe, Uwera wa Isirayeli Umukiza wawe. Nagutangiriye Egiputa ho incungu, Etiyopiya n'i Seba nahatanze ku bwawe.

4.text: Kuko wambereye inkoramutima kandi ukaba uwo kubahwa nanjye nkagukunda, ni cyo kizatuma ntanga ingabo zigapfa ku bwawe, n'amahanga nkayatangirira ubugingo bwawe.

5.text: Ntutinye ndi kumwe nawe, nzazana urubyaro rwawe ndukure iburasirazuba, nzagukoranya ngukure iburengerazuba.

6.text: Nzabwira ikasikazi nti ‘Barekure’, n'ikusi mpabwire nti ‘Wibīmana.’ Nzanira abahungu banjye bave kure, n'abakobwa banjye bave ku mpera y'isi,

7.text: nzanira umuntu wese witiriwe izina ryanjye, uwo naremeye kumpesha icyubahiro. Ni jye wamuremye, ni jye wamubumbye.”

8.text: Sohora impumyi zifite amaso n'ibipfamatwi bifite amatwi,

9.text: amahanga yose akoranywe, amoko yose aterane. Hari abo muri bo babasha kutubwira bakatwereka ibyabayeho? Nibatange abagabo batsindishirizwe. Cyangwa se bumve bemere ko ari iby'ukuri.

10.text: “Mwebwe n'umugaragu wanjye natoranije muri abagabo bo guhamya ibyanjye”, ni ko Uwiteka avuga, “Kugira ngo mumenye, munyizere, munyitegereze ko ari jye. Nta mana yambanjirije kubaho, kandi nta yizamperuka.

11.text: “Jyewe, jye ubwanjye ni jyewe Uwiteka, kandi nta wundi mukiza utari jyewe.

12.text: Ni jye wabwirije iby'agakiza kandi ndakiza, ndabigaragaza kandi muri mwe nta yindi mana yahabaye, ni cyo gituma muri abagabo bo kumpamya ko ari jyewe Mana.” Ni ko Uwiteka avuga.

13.text: “Kandi koko uhereye aho umucyo wabereyeho ndi we, nta wubasha gutesha ukuboko kwanjye. Ubwo nzakora umurimo ni nde uzankoma mu nkokora?”

14.text: Uwiteka umucunguzi wanyu, Uwera wa Isirayeli aravuga ati “Ku bwanyu natumye i Babuloni nzamanura abaho bose ari impunzi, ari bo Bakaludaya bazahunganwa n'inkuge zabo biratanaga.

15.text: Ni jyewe Uwiteka Uwera wanyu, Umuremyi wa Isirayeli n'Umwami wanyu.”

16.text: Umva ibyo Uwiteka avuga, ari we waremye inzira mu nyanja agacisha inzira mu mazi menshi,

17.text: agasohora amagare n'amafarashi: ingabo n'intwari baguye hamwe ntibazabyuka, bazimye nk'uko bazimya imuri.

18.text: “Ibya kera ntimubyibuke, kandi ibyashize mwe kubyitaho.

19.text: Dore ngiye gukora ikintu gishya, ubu ko kigiye kwaduka ntimuzakimenya? Nzaharura inzira mu butayu, ntembeshe imigezi mu kidaturwa.

20.text: Inyamaswa zo mu gasozi, ingunzu n'imbuni bizanyubaha, kuko ntanga amazi mu butayu, ngatembesha imigezi mu kidaturwa, kugira ngo nuhire ubwoko bwanjye natoranije,

21.text: abantu niremeye ubwanjye ngo berekane ishimwe ryanjye.

22.text: “Ariko Yakobo we, ntabwo wantakiye. Isirayeli we, waranzinutswe.

23.text: Ntabwo wanzaniye amatungo yawe magufi ngo untambire ibitambo byoswa, kandi ntumpesheje icyubahiro ibitambo byawe. Sinagukoresheje umurimo w'amaturo, kandi sinakuvunishije kunyosereza imibavu.

24.text: Ntiwatanze ifeza ngo ungurire ibihumura neza, kandi ntiwampagije ibinure by'ibitambo byawe, ahubwo wankoreye ibyaha byawe, wamvunishije ibicumuro byawe.

25.text: Ubwanjye ni jye uhanagura ibicumuro byawe nkakubabarira ku bwanjye, kandi ibyaha byawe sinzabyibuka ukundi.

26.text: “Nyibutsa tuburane, shinga urubanza rwawe kugira ngo utsindishirizwe.

27.text: Sogokuruza wa mbere yakoze icyaha, n'abigisha bawe bancumuyeho.

28.text: Ni cyo kizatuma nsuzuguza abatware b'ubuturo bwera, kandi Yakobo nzamuhindura ikivume, Isirayeli nzamuhindura igitutsi.
